scope.beginning: The episode begins with Rhea pregnant again after Cronus has swallowed her earlier children.
scope.ending: It ends with Zeus hidden in Crete while Cronus believes he has swallowed the newborn.

narrative.synopsis: Rhea refuses to lose another child to Cronus. With older divine help, she hides Zeus in Crete and gives Cronus a wrapped stone, preserving the child who will break Titan rule.
narrative.openingSituation: Rhea has watched Cronus swallow every child before Zeus.
narrative.centralConflict: The newborn must be hidden from a father who consumes his heirs.
narrative.resolution: Cronus swallows the stone and is deceived.
narrative.outcome: Zeus survives in secret, making the future revolt possible.

events.consequence: Rhea seeks help before the birth.
Zeus is born away from Cronus’ control.
The infant is concealed in Crete.
A wrapped stone replaces the child.
Cronus consumes the stone and believes Zeus is gone.
